name: ucl-moodle-mcp
description: Give Claude access to your UCL Moodle courses, assignments, grades, quizzes, calendar, forums, and notifications.
long_description:
Connects Claude to UCL Moodle (moodle.ucl.ac.uk). Ask about upcoming deadlines, check your grades, browse course resources, read assignment feedback, and more, all in natural language.

Needs a Moodle token: run `npm create ucl-moodle-mcp` or see the README.

moodle_token.title: UCL Moodle token
moodle_token.description: 32-character token from the Moodle mobile-app login (see README > Getting your token).
